title: Turkish Locative Case (-da / -de / -ta / -te)
explanation: Adds '-da/-de' according to vowel harmony. Becomes '-ta/-te' after unvoiced consonants (Fıstıkçı Şahap).

example_translations.ex_trloc_1: Ali is at home right now.

common_error_explanations.err_trloc_1: Check vowel harmony and consonant assimilation (evde, kitapta).
